name: Home Services
title: Referral Partners for Home Services | Our Local Network
description: We visit the hardware stores, real estate offices and movers near your home service business in Naperville and Hinsdale, and track every sign-up.
cardBlurb: We visit the hardware stores, real estate offices and movers homeowners use.
intro: We find businesses near you that homeowners already use. Every month we visit them and introduce your business by name.
partnersIntro: People moving or fixing up a home stop here when a job comes up.

partners.name: Hardware stores
partners.why: Some homeowners find out partway through that the job needs a pro.

partners.name: Real estate offices
partners.why: Buyers and sellers need repairs and move-in work, often on a deadline.

partners.name: Property management offices
partners.why: Managers keep a short list of pros for every unit and tenant request.

partners.name: Moving companies
partners.why: People settling into a new home need local pros they can trust.

partners.name: Self-storage facilities
partners.why: Renters are often in the middle of a move, a remodel or both.

partners.name: Appliance stores
partners.why: A new washer or range can need a plumber or electrician to finish the job.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the counter to the front office.
treatExamples: Coffee and donuts for a hardware store's opening crew
Bagels and coffee for a real estate office's morning meeting
Muffins and coffee for a property management office's front desk
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal. Your office calls back and sets up the job.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: When our team visits, you and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No one in your trade
notes.text: We never visit businesses in your trade for you.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We describe your services only in words you approve.

exclusivity: When our team visits, each partner agrees to promote one business in your trade, yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Can't I just walk into the hardware store myself?
faq.a: You can. The hard part is finding the right businesses, visiting every month and tracking every sign-up.

faq.q: I already know a few real estate agents. Will you visit them?
faq.a: Not unless you ask. We skip businesses you already work with, and those relationships stay yours.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit, and you see each stop in your portal.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my home service business.
